Work sites. So it begins... Sequoyah

By mrogers May 16, 2025

The first work site destination is also the closest. Sequoyah. I work on so many computers in this site it's unreal, I also see this site as I go down the mountain into Soddy weekly, yet until May 17 2025, I had not visited. So I said what the hell and went!

The first thing I noticed after being a little intimidated to approach even though I had credentials, was the noise generating electricity makes. It's a consistent hum around a 50-60 MHz. It’s all around you. I’m sure inside might be quieter.

Anyway, as I rode around I saw a deer eating on grounds, (This will become a common thing at these sites as you will see.) And what I believe is a fantastic place to fish out the back, if I can do it without getting into too much trouble! 

More about Sequoyah HERE!

So this was the first. I plan to visit as many as I can this summer.
